svg.title: VetReady: Vet exam prep with a timed CBT simulation, guided OSCE cases, checkout, and portals for participants and admins.
svg.desc: Project card for VetReady, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts scrolling. Vet exam prep with a timed CBT simulation, guided OSCE cases, checkout, and portals for participants and admins. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Framer Motion.
